# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.5

## Unreleased

## Fixed

- A C300X whose own `c300x` SIP user is missing (for example after an entrance-
  panel swap) is now reported honestly: media readiness no longer shows `ready`
  while on-demand video fails. The fix names it in the self-test
  (`device_sip_user_missing`) and points at re-registering the device through the
  BTicino app, which re-provisions that user and its certificates — something
  Home Assistant cannot do itself.

## Security

- Release SBOMs now pass official SPDX 2.3 validation and include the required
  package verification data alongside SHA-256 integrity checks.
- The release workflow verifies both SLSA provenance and SPDX SBOM Sigstore
  bundles against the release workflow, tag ref and commit before publication.
